summary: Comprehensive testing of 4 new features: (1) Thumbnail selection for product images, (2) Custom domain mapping, (3) Floating icons fix, (4) Dynamic theme color on storefront. All 23 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing confirmed all features working correctly.

seed_data_creation: Test orders created during checkout flow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: 4 new features tested and working: (1) Thumbnail selection - clicking non-first image in product edit modal moves it to first position with 'Thumbnail' badge, (2) Custom domain - Settings tab has input field and save button, saves to backend, (3) Floating icons fix - container has pointer-events-none so products behind are clickable, (4) Theme color - storefront uses dynamic theme_color from shop data, all buttons/prices/badges reflect the color. Theme color was changed to green (#10B981) during testing.

thumbnail_selection.details: Product edit modal shows multi-image preview with 'Thumbnail' badge on first image. Clicking non-first image reorders array.

custom_domain.details: Settings tab has Custom Domain card with input field, CNAME instructions, and save button. Saves to backend via PUT /api/dashboard/shop.

floating_icons_fix.details: FloatingActions container has pointer-events-none, only buttons have pointer-events-auto. Products behind floating icons are clickable.

dynamic_theme_color.details: Storefront uses shop.theme_color via CSS variable --tc. All buttons, prices, badges reflect the color. Tested with green (#10B981).
